invariants: Raw message, thread, checkout, payment, recipient, sender, subject, body, and snippet data never enter the repository.
A zero count is scoped only to the explicit observation window and query contract; it is never generalized to all outreach.
OBSERVED evidence may update current telemetry but cannot create a definitive PASSED/FAILED experiment outcome.
Definitive external outcomes still require VERIFIED evidence and an independent verifier under the experiment contract.
Stale or absent observations fail closed to UNKNOWN.
